title: Production prompt stratification & reservoir sampling for FP8/INT8 calibration packs
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a production-focused calibration dataset curation and sampling strategy that produces compact, stable per-domain calibration packs for FP8 and INT8 quantization validation. Packs must reflect production prompt diversity and traffic distribution, preserve rare but high-risk prompt classes, and be efficient enough for nightly quant-regression runs and canary rollouts.

High-level approach: create stratified reservoir sampling over a combined space of (domain, prompt-signature hash, token-length bucket, recency window), with per-domain budget allocation proportional to 7-day active traffic share but with floor guarantees to protect low-traffic domains. Keep a separate exemplar anchor set per domain for deterministic regression checks. Produce two pack types: (1) daily delta packs (~1k prompts) for rollout validation, and (2) stable core packs (~10k prompts) used for model qualification and quant profile tuning.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

Why this ticket: existing calibration efforts sample per-domain but either over-index on long-tail noisy prompts or fail to capture temporal drift. This plan balances representativeness, sensitivity to regressions, and runtime constraints for nightly validation pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline produces daily delta packs and monthly stable packs for all active domains
Per-domain pack sizes match configured budget with floor guarantees (min 200 prompts/domain for stable pack)
Reservoir sampling logic respects token-length buckets and preserves at least 5 exemplars per rare intent class
Quant-regression run using FP8 and INT8 profiles on stable pack completes within CI budget (<= 2 hours) and produces per-domain accuracy delta report
Canary rollout validation consumes daily delta pack and triggers rollback on >2% top-1 token accuracy regression for high-impact domains
implementation_notes: Pipeline will be implemented as a Spark job that consumes anonymized prompt telemetry from the raft-prod pipeline (S3 prefix: s3://redwood-prod/prompt-telemetry/deduped/). Sampling parameters are configuration-driven via config repo: github.com/redwood-inference/configs/tree/main/calibration. Reservoir state for each domain will be checkpointed to Dynamo (table: calibration-reservoirs) to enable incremental updates without recomputing full history. Anchor exemplars stored in Pinboard (Confluence doc + Drive snapshot) for auditability.
experiment_plan: 1) Run ablation comparing pure proportional sampling vs. proportional with token-length bucketing on a held-out 30k prompt set. 2) Evaluate sensitivity: what percent of regression events are caught by daily delta packs of size 1k vs 2k? 3) Compute per-domain and per-signature KL-divergence between traffic and sampled distribution to tune bucketing weights.
evaluation_metrics: Per-prompt top-1 token accuracy delta (baseline FP32 -> quant profile), per-sequence pass/fail for deterministic tests, overall KL divergence to production prompt distribution, CI runtime for quant-regression, false-positive rollback rate during canary validation.
comments: 2026-02-11 - Maya Chen: Initial scoping done. Spoke with Data Platform; they can provide 30-day sliding window telemetry with dedup keys and token counts. Confirmed Dynamo table for reservoir checkpoints is available.

2026-02-18 - Ravi Kapoor: Prototype reservoir sampler implemented and validated on 10M prompt sample. Observed that naive proportional sampling overweights long prompts; token-length bucketing reduced variance in per-token error by ~18%.

2026-02-26 - ML Validation (Ana Gomez): Ran FP8 vs INT8 on prototype stable pack. FP8 shows 0.9% median top-1 delta vs FP32, INT8 shows 2.7%. Need to tighten exemplar selection for intents with templated tokens to catch INT8 regressions.

2026-03-02 - Design review (Priya Nair): UX for pack provenance approved. Requested clear metadata fields (domain, sampling_policy_hash, generation_time, traffic_window) included in pack manifest. Added to implementation notes.

2026-03-05 - Security (Dmitri Petrov): Confirmed telemetry feed complies with PII redaction policy; flagged that exemplar storage must be encrypted at rest using KMS key 'calibration-exemplars-prod'. Added to configs.

2026-03-07 - Ravi Kapoor: Integrated canary runner hook. Canary run simulated with 100 recent requests for payments domain; no regressions observed. Next: run full daily delta across top 20 domains and gather regression signal statistics.

2026-03-09 - Maya Chen: Decided trade-off: daily delta pack will prioritize recency (70%) and diversity (30%) to favor drift detection while preserving rare classes. Documented threshold for exemplar eviction: LRU by last-seen timestamp but pinned if labeled as high-risk intent.

Follow-ups: update runbook for rollback triggers, add automated alert to PagerDuty for canary regressions on P0 domains, and schedule post-mortem template for any false rollback within first month of rollout.
